description: Documentaries about past events, people and places. Research leans on records and archives; graphics lean on maps, documents and chronology.
entity_handling: Prefer primary and archival sources over secondary summaries when both are retrieved.
Period place names and spellings from the script are kept; modern equivalents are never substituted silently.
A date stays script_asserted until a retrieved source supports it — period sources routinely disagree, and disagreements are recorded as conflicts, never resolved silently.
label: History
music_mood: Somber orchestral / period instrumentation (metadata only — no music library is integrated; the soundtrack remains user-supplied or absent).

pacing.notes: Informational only — narration is not retimed to pacing targets.
